title: Understanding Cross Validation
text: In 7-fold cross-validation, the dataset is divided into $$7$$ parts. Each part is used as a validation set once, while the remaining $$6$$ parts are used for training. Can you think about how many times each data point is used in training?

title: Exploring Hyperparameter Combinations
text: Milena is testing $$2$$ values of lambda and $$5$$ values of rho. How many different combinations of these hyperparameters will she test?

title: Calculating Model Fits
text: How many models will Milena fit in total if she tests each combination of lambda and rho using 7-fold cross-validation?

title: Data Point Usage in Training
text: Each data point is used in training for $$6$$ out of the $$7$$ folds. Given that there are $$10$$ hyperparameter combinations, how many times is each data point used in training across all models?
